text:
alex: Thinking out loud — can we unify flag inheritance so service-level flags cascade to route-level unless explicitly set? trying to avoid per-route duplication.
maria: +1 for inheritance, but we need clear override semantics. what happens to telemetry when child overrides a flag? :thinking_face:
jordan: If route overrides, we should tag telemetry with both effective value and origin (inherited|local). otherwise dashboards lie.
alex: Agree. Proposal: add `origin` field to eval logs and a `resolved_path` that shows which key resolved it. e.g. `{\"flag\":\"quota_enabled\",\"value\":false,\"origin\":\"service:payments\"}`
nate: That'll bloat logs. can we sample non-error evals? ops wants full audit for security flags though.
jeff: SRE needs full audit for auth/ratelimit flags. sampling OK for perf-related flags. propose two-tier log: `audit` (always) + `telemetry` (sampled).
maria: UX note: Console should show both layers — collapsed by default, expand to see inherited values. also add a breadcrumb like "service > route".
jordan: For rollout safety, we should support `inherited_lock` so parent can mark child non-overridable for N hours. prevents immediate escapes during rollout.
alex: Nice. PR sketch: new fields in config model: `inherits_from: string | null`, `overrideable: boolean`, `inherit_lock_ttl: int?`. Also change flags eval API `/v1/flags/eval` to return `origin` and `inherited_chain`.
ops-bot: deploy-check: lint OK, model migration required: 2026_05_add_flag_origin_col.
nate: migration concerns — we need backfill: null => local for existing flags. ensure backfill runs in low-traffic maintenance window.
jeff: also add circuit to revert to parent behavior if evaluation latency increases >50ms p50. we can't let evals add too much latency to request path.
alex: Good catch. We'll offload heavy tracing to async collector. eval API returns minimal origin tag but full chain is emitted to event stream.
maria: Dashboard asks: how to surface rollout progress per-flag? need count of requests hitting inherited vs local, error delta, and slo impact.
jordan: Telemetry schema suggestion: send `flag_eval` events with fields: `flag`, `value`, `origin_type`, `origin_id`, `route_id`, `timestamp`, `sample_rate`. backend can aggregate per-flag and compute deltas.
jeff: We'll add a sampling header `X-Flag-Sample` so downstream pipeline can up/down-sample.
nate: Who owns the console changes? @jordan you?
jordan: i'll pair with @maria. i'll open a design doc with examples and a small prototype.
alex: Action items: 1) schema PR (alex) 2) migration plan + backfill (nate) 3) console wireframes + prototype (jordan+maria) 4) SRE circuit and latency guard (jeff) 5) telemetry schema and sampling header (jeff+nate)
maria: timeline: aim for alpha in 2 sprints, rollout to internal canary then 3-stage customer rollout.
jeff: can we add an automated smoke that flips an inherited flag to local in canary and checks errors?
alex: yep — add to rollout playbook.
jordan: I'll paste initial wireframe later. :eyes:
ops-bot: task-created: #BF-4392 schema PR; #BF-4393 migration; #BF-4394 console; #BF-4395 telemetry; #BF-4396 rollout-smoke.
alex: thanks all. filing RFC draft now.
